description: Agent Healthcare: submit a discharge summary with the follow-up plan given to the patient: the summary with the day discharged, the facility, each follow-up with whom, within how many days or on which day, each medication change with the medication and its kind (start, stop, change dose or continue), each activity and care instruction, each warning sign and the return instructions; the plan with the day given and the same follow-ups, medication changes, instructions, warning signs and return instructions as given. The signed report gives the discharge with the day the plan was given, the follow-ups recorded and in the plan with those missing and those with other timing, the medication changes recorded and in the plan with those missing and those stated otherwise, the instructions written and those missing from the plan with the return instructions given or missing, and the warning signs stated and those missing from the plan, and counts them, and names an inconsistent plan: a follow-up in the discharge summary missing from the plan, a recorded medication change missing from it, a medication change it states otherwise, a warning sign missing from it and return instructions it leaves out; then a follow-up with other timing, an activity or care instruction missing from it, a plan item the discharge summary does not record and a plan given after discharge, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No follow-ups, medication changes or warning signs in the discharge summary, or a plan silent on follow-ups, medication changes, instructions or warning signs the summary states leaves the plan unverified. Follow-ups match by whom they are with, medication changes by medication and kind, and instructions and signs by their words. This reads a care transition’s paperwork: wever_handover-check reads an operator’s handover package before a receiver takes over, and wever_handoff-record-check reads an agent system’s task handoff records, while the discharge check reads what a discharge summary records against the plan the patient receives. Verdict health_discharge_inconsistent, health_discharge_partial, health_discharge_unverified or health_discharge_consistent. POST /api/health-discharge-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.
